verdict.line: You lose if you let him farm to level 6 for free; you win if you punish every stand-and-trade before he has Ossaic Form.

brief.thesis: K'Sante has almost no reliable damage or escape before rank 2 E (Skirmish) and before his R (All Out) meter unlocks Ossaic Form at 6, so Sett's passive Pit Grit and the W (Haymaker) heal-on-low-HP let you win every extended melee trade in that window. The matchup flips once he hits 6: Ossaic Form gives him bonus resists, tenacity, and an unstoppable follow-up dash that makes his all-ins much safer. Structurally, this is a lane you either close out early or play patient through mid-game.

theirWindow.when: E (Skirmish) up and Q (Ntofo Strikes) at 3 stacks
theirWindow.what: He can dash in for an empowered auto and disengage safely. Don't stand in melee range trading autos here — back off a step or force him to walk up instead.

yourWindow.when: E (Skirmish) just used or on cooldown
yourWindow.what: He has no gap closer or escape. Walk up and force the trade — throw E (Facebreaker) first cast to zone, then all-in with Q (Knuckle Down) and R (The Show Stopper) if he's stuck.

start.why: Negates his early auto poke entirely and keeps you healthy for the level 3-5 all-in window.

boots.why: His entire kit is auto-attack and physical burst; the flat reduction blunts his empowered Q (Ntofo Strikes) auto and any all-in.

core.why: The empowered-auto proc and movement speed let you stick through his E (Skirmish) escape dash.
Crit-on-cooldown-reduction and the heal proc on ability crit keep you winning extended trades into his tank stats.
The shield and tenacity keep you alive through his Ossaic Form all-in after level 6.

you're ahead and need to blunt his attack speed and R engage in teamfights
the game goes long and you need to survive burst from his Ossaic Form combo
the enemy team has picked up burst that threatens to one-shot you post-6

runes.keystoneWhy: Ramps through the extended melee trades this lane is built on and the adaptive force scales your all-in damage before items.

summoners.why: Teleport lets you reset the wave after an early all-in and gives you map presence once you fall off as a pure laner post-6; Flash is needed to guarantee E (Facebreaker) lands or to dodge his R engage.

playing.title: Punish stand-and-trade before level 3
playing.detail: Every auto he lands into you fills your Grit passive faster than his damage matters, and it comes back as a free empowered Q (Knuckle Down).

playing.title: Only all-in when E is down
playing.detail: K'Sante has zero escape without E (Skirmish). If you see him use it to trade or reposition, walk up immediately — he can't run.

playing.title: Zone with E before you grab
playing.detail: Throw E (Facebreaker)'s first cast to knock him toward you or a wall before committing the second-cast pull, especially if he's near his own W (Path Maker) wall spot.

playing.title: Race to a kill before 6
playing.detail: Once his R (All Out) meter fills and he unlocks Ossaic Form he gets bonus resists and tenacity that make later all-ins much riskier for you.

playing.title: Hold trades for a full Grit bar
playing.detail: Don't spend Grit stacks on a half-charged bar — waiting one extra auto for the full empowered proc wins more trades than it costs.

playing.title: Bait Skirmish, then punish the landing
playing.detail: After 6, dodge his first E (Skirmish) dash and immediately follow with R (The Show Stopper) since he can't cleanly disengage once it's on cooldown.

brief.patchCaveat: Item and rune names reflect the last build I'm confident in (Trinity Force / Sundered Sky / Sterak's Gage core, Conqueror keystone) — check current patch notes for numbers on K'Sante's Ossaic Form stats and Sett's item pricing, as both have been tuning targets recently.
